response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifacts FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT f.traitregistry, f.zoneref, f.articount, 1.0 * f.articount / NULLIF(t.artifacts, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE f.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.artifacts IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST, s.zoneref, s.traitregistry LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each nonmissing scanfeatures.articount is a separate count, even when several rows have the same site code.

alternatives.interpretation: Combine artifact counts for each site before calculating shares and their average.
alternatives.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifacts FROM scanfeatures), site_counts AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS articount FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref HAVING COUNT(articount) > 0), shares AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, 1.0 * s.articount / NULLIF(t.artifacts, 0) AS share FROM site_counts AS s CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.artifacts IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST, s.zoneref LIMIT 10;
